google_overhead_review.review: Preserved the four unequal stands, deep chamfered Trinity roof and Holte end. Regularised the tiny gap beside the north-corner building into a shared junction, avoiding two edges merging at A3 pen weight. This is a small cartographic simplification, not a measured relocation of the building. The road hidden under Trinity Stand is suppressed only beneath the roof.
